label: Location
definition: Location of the treatment plant, as a single point geometry (a latitude and longitude pair) in ETRS89 (EPSG:4258) or WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), with at least four decimal places ({ref}`sp-location`).

label: INSPIRE local identifier
definition: Local identifier of the same object in a national INSPIRE dataset.
condition: Required if an INSPIRE identifier has been assigned; give with `inspireIdNamespace`

label: INSPIRE version identifier
definition: Version of the object in that INSPIRE dataset, where the source uses versions.

label: Code
definition: Code of the treatment plant. A new plant receives a new code; an existing one keeps its code ({ref}`sp-reporting`). A code from the reporting under Directive 91/271/EEC that does not meet the WISE identifier rules is converted ({ref}`sp-code-conversion`).

label: English name
definition: Existing English version of the name, if available. No translation is required.

label: Name
definition: Official name of the treatment plant, or a working name for a proposed plant.

label: Version start
definition: Date on which this version of the treatment plant was inserted or changed.

label: Version end
definition: Date on which the treatment plant was retired.

label: Predecessors
definition: Codes of the treatment plants this one replaces, given once, in the delivery in which the change happens. Several codes are separated by commas.

label: Evolution type
definition: What is being reported: no change, a new object, a change, a merger, a split or a retirement.

label: Designation start
definition: Date from which the treatment plant is in the scope of the Directive.

label: Designation end
definition: Date on which the treatment plant left the scope of the Directive.
condition: Required when the treatment plant leaves the scope of the Directive

label: Condition
definition: Physical state of the plant: proposed, under construction, in use, disused or decommissioned.

label: Capacity
definition: Organic design capacity of the treatment plant, in population equivalent (p.e.).
